name: qwen38_split
description: Local two-machine llama-server split of Qwen3.8-27B over an OpenAI-compatible API. Same endpoint the Librarian uses (http://127.0.0.1:8081). Start it with ~/.local/llama/qwen38-split.sh. Context is 4096 tokens — the split is launched with -c 4096.

env_vars.name: QWEN38_SPLIT_HOST
env_vars.description: Base URL of the Qwen3.8-27B llama-server split (default: http://127.0.0.1:8081)
